name: Counter Plugin
author: PrismAI
description: A stateful example plugin that maintains a persistent counter within its Worker Thread. Demonstrates module-scoped state that persists across tool calls within the same Worker lifecycle.

increment.description: Increment the counter by a specified amount. Returns the new count.

amount.description: The amount to increment by. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

get_count.description: Returns the current value of the counter without modifying it.
